_note: bbox is a constant. Never geocode it at runtime - that adds an API dependency for a value that never changes.
_grid_note: 5x5=25 tiles. Places caps a text query at 60 results (3 pages x 20), so a coarse grid silently truncates dense belts like Saravanampatti. Finer tiles stop the cap binding. 25 tiles x 8 keywords x 3 pages = 600 requests/vertical worst case.
